description: Small, hand-authored reproducible eval set: a tiny corpus plus queries with known-relevant documents and expected answer keywords. Intentionally small to be genuinely reviewable rather than impressive-looking.

corpus.text: Vertex AI Vector Search is a managed service for high-scale, low-latency approximate nearest neighbor retrieval over dense embedding vectors. It is commonly used as the retrieval backbone for retrieval-augmented generation systems built on Gemini.

Cloud Run is a fully managed serverless platform that runs stateless containers and automatically scales to zero when there is no traffic, charging only for the resources used during request processing.
Gemini models accept multimodal input including text, images, audio, and PDF documents, and can reason jointly across these modalities within a single prompt.
Google Cloud IAM lets administrators grant fine-grained access to resources by assigning roles to principals, following the principle of least privilege for service accounts.
